caption:
Most people ask AI a question and take the first answer. 😬 Try this instead.

Add ONE line to your prompt:
"Before you answer, ask me 3 questions to understand what I need."

Now the AI stops guessing and starts using YOUR details, so the answer actually fits you. 🎯

📌 Save this for your next prompt.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.
